description: This is a PHP unit test class for ImapHandlerFactory, testing methods for saving test settings keys and retrieving an ImapHandler instance.

classes.name: ImapHandlerFactoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing ImapHandlerFactory methods.

methods.name: testSaveTestSettingsKeyInvalidKey
